verdict.rationale: Mercury documents card limits and spend controls, and its Cards API lets you manage spending limits. A long-time customer reports creating hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits and purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules. That gives enforced spend limits at the card level, but nothing shows a department- or program-level budget object that aggregates and enforces spend across cards or users. Missing for 10: documented department/program budget entities, budget-level enforcement across multiple cards or users, and budget tracking or reporting against limits.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set department or program budgets with automatically enforced spend limits

citations.quote: Curb team spend with card limits, spend controls, and granular user permissions.
control team expenses with cards, reimbursements, limits, and approvals all in one place.
You can now issue virtual cards, manage spending limits, and control card lifecycle states — all through the API.
